# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-two years old in Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v4 c8 P11](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, twenty-year-old youth with a round, expressionless, freckle-covered face. He is described as a heavy-set lad who has an unvarying, cheerful smile or smirk.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)_

## Personality

Barney is quiet, phlegmatic, and possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter, often remaining silent in social settings. He is extremely timid and bashful, particularly around girls, and lacks the courage to make a marriage proposal directly. Despite his silence, he possesses an underlying pride and is deeply admired by his family.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P11](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0011), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)_

## Traits

- Bashful and timid  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Quiet and reserved  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Hardworking and reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a carriage and team  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Farming  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and settle down on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen grows up in Brierley as the son of Gorham Pullen. In his youth, he drives a double-seated buggy to transport local girls, including Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, to the Sunday-school picnic and the Pale Sands Hotel concert. Later, his father gifts him the upper farm in his own name. Being enamored with Nell Harcourt but too shy to ask her himself, he persuades his sister Odette to propose marriage on his behalf, offering to wait until she finishes college. After Nell declines, he turns his attentions to Nettie Scobie and marries her shortly before her 'appearing out' at church.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
